description: Permanently deletes a post in any status (draft, scheduled, failed or published) from JuzPost, with its per-account rows. A scheduled post's timer is cancelled first, so it never publishes; a published post's analytics in JuzPost go with it. Use this only when the user explicitly asks to delete the post. Returns deleted=true, the post id and what the deleted post was (title, caption, type, media count). Does NOT remove anything already published on a platform: the post stays there and has to be deleted on the platform itself.
name: delete_post
title: Delete a post
